rationale: Election set for Oct 27. The far right is campaigning on resettling Gaza: on Jul 19 Smotrich and Ben-Gvir led a march to the Gaza perimeter (CNN Jul 20), and Smotrich's party is polling below the threshold, which gives him a reason to grab headlines. Katz pushes 'large-scale migration' plus Nahal outposts (Jul 18). No named removal plan has been reported yet.

June FFPI (Jul 3): veg oils +3.8%, meat +0.4% (record), sugar -5.7%, cereals -3.5%, dairy -1.5%. In July, sugar hit a 2.25-month high (Jul 8) on a weak Indian monsoon and the CPC's 'one of strongest in 75 yrs' El Nino, then swung back; crude reached a 5-week high (Jul 21); Black Sea attacks lifted Euronext wheat 7% (Jul 8), so cereals are up a bit.

Indonesia is already escalating: 10 South Sumatra regencies plus the province (to Nov 30) and South Kalimantan province (Jul 6) declared 'siaga darurat karhutla', with the dry-season peak expected Aug-Sep under a strong El Nino. Malaysia warns of transboundary haze from Jul to Oct but historically rarely declares an emergency (it needs API >500).

Mbappe won the World Cup Golden Boot with 10 goals (Jul 19) and was La Liga's top scorer; Bellingham scored 7 at the World Cup. Madrid's opener was moved to Aug 26 and Mourinho's first league game is at Espanyol on Aug 22. There is no news of Vinicius leaving.

No bank-specific signal. Treasury is active under 'Operation Economic Fury': exchange houses and Ali Ansari were designated Jul 10 and CBI-linked crypto wallets frozen Jul 14, and the US is pressing Iraq over Iran-aligned militias. Kept diffuse.

AP (Jul 3) and the Independent (Jul 21): Texas is the 'center of the battle'. Thune and GOP leaders want Trump's MAGA Inc. ($382M cash) to fund Paxton, who was outraised by Talarico by $26M and has $1.8M on hand, and SLF says it won't lead in Texas. North Carolina (Whatley, a Trump pick) is the other named target.

La Liga (Jul 14) moved the Barca and Madrid openers to Aug 26-27, so neither has a game in hand by Sep 20. Barca start at Elche (Aug 23) and Madrid at Espanyol (Aug 22). The big two usually lead after MD5; Barca's game at Valencia is the last fixture.

WHO DON (Jul 17): 2,124 cases in 5 provinces, 89.6% in Ituri. North Kivu has 11 affected health zones, 2,360 contacts and isolation at 120% (Jul 15). WHO's incident manager (Jul 21) named Katwa/Butembo as the hot spot for the next rapid response. Kisangani (Tshopo) has only 5 imported cases and no secondary spread.

Antonelli won Spa from pole (Jul 19): 6 wins in 10 rounds, Mercedes have all 10 poles, and he leads by 45. Leclerc was 2nd and Verstappen 3rd (from the front row). Russell crashed out on lap 1 and complains of a 'mystery issue'. McLaren are off the pace. Monza is low-drag like Spa.

No news since Mo Chatra (Apr 8) said the Standard Chartered deal (about GBP50m/yr) won't be renewed after 2026-27 and LFC wants GBP70m+. No bidders are named. Kept diffuse and trimmed the incumbent slightly.

On Jun 25 Commerce/Census posted the title of a proposed rule, 'Proposed Residence Criteria...'. Experts (TPM, Jul 15) expect undocumented and temporarily present immigrants (TPS, DACA, visa holders) to be counted as foreign residents. That matches the Missouri suit's push to exclude illegal aliens and temporary visa holders, which leaves LPRs.

Saudi forces took Mayun from UAE-aligned forces in Jan 2026 (Al Arabiya). It is held under a joint Saudi-Yemeni command with a Saudi-funded coast guard. The July Houthi-Saudi escalation (naval embargo Jul 20, threats to close Bab el-Mandeb) adds some Houthi risk. The UAE was dropped.

BBC Ukraine (Jul 14): the station campaign has spread to Sumy and Chernihiv oblasts and near Pyriatyn (Poltava oblast). HUR (Jul 17) says Russia ordered more strikes on gas stations in frontline and border areas, and Zhytomyr banned station operation during alerts. Recent hits were in Kharkiv (Jul 14) and Mykolaiv (Jul 20), both near-front cities.

Yihune won Xiamen (12:57.32) and Oslo (12:47.62 WL). Lobalu won Monaco (Jul 10) ahead of Blanks and Balew, and Balew was 2nd in Oslo with an Asian record. Hocker, the 2025 world champion, qualifies automatically. Ingebrigtsen had not raced in 2026 after Feb Achilles surgery (Irish Times, Jul 4), so he was dropped.

AFP (Jul 11): the trial is set for Sep 10-11 at the Paris tribunal correctionnel with three adults: Kherbouch 'Ganito' (alleged main organizer, recidivist, escaped Villepinte in Mar 2026), co-organizer Khyan M. 'Kiki', and one executant (Bakary). Two minors were already sentenced in early July (4 and 3 years). Daril B. is not among the adult defendants.

At Wimbledon, Fritz (6th seed) reached the QF and lost to finalist Zverev, while Shelton (4th seed) lost in R1 to qualifier Virtanen. Tien was seeded 16, Tiafoe 17 and Paul 21. The US Open draw is about Aug 27.

The lineup is due Jul 23. Predictions (IONCINEMA Jul 18, Whitlock&Pope Jul 20) have Lee Chang-dong's Possible Love (TIFF North American premiere; IONCINEMA's Golden Lion pick), Herzog, Moretti, Amelio's Nessun dolore, Martone and Kore-eda. Italian films won this prize in 2019, 2021 and 2025. Re-forecast after the lineup.

The 2026 majors went to Rybakina (AO), Andreeva (RG) and Noskova (Wimbledon). Sabalenka, US Open champion in 2024 and 2025, lost to Osaka in the Wimbledon R16. Gauff reached the Wimbledon SF; Swiatek is in a slump (RG R4, early Wimbledon loss to Eala).

Yan is unbeaten in 2026 with 4 Diamond League wins (71.74 Xiamen, 67.11 Oslo, 67.44 Paris, 68.75 Monaco on Jul 10), is world No. 1 and the only 70m+ thrower. Vilagos was 2nd in Monaco with 63.18. The UC field is 8. The risks are a skip for Asian Games prep or a bad day.
Nothing material. Villa finished 4th and won the Europa League; Forest were 16th. Tielemans may leave Villa for Man Utd (Jul 13) and Anderson may leave Forest. Kept.
No decisive news. United (Carrick) are signing Andrey Santos and chasing Tielemans; City are rebuilding after Guardiola. Kept.

Lyles qualifies automatically as 2025 world champion and is in this week's US 200m; Bednarek isn't entered (NBC, Jul 20). Tebogo won Oslo in 19.84. 18-year-old Tate Taylor beat Tebogo at Eugene in 19.75 into a headwind (Jul 4). Gout Gout's season is over (hamstring tear, Jul 9).

Talks stalled during the Iran war. In a Jul 4 call Trump offered to help, and Witkoff/Kushner may visit Moscow soon (RIA, Jul 8). At the Ankara NATO summit Trump asked Zelensky whether he would attend talks in Moscow. Earlier rounds were in Abu Dhabi and Geneva; Zelensky had said Switzerland or Turkiye, and the US floated Miami in Feb.

Pathirage leads the world (92.62 in Rome, Jun 4), won Doha (88.68, Jun 19) and has won 6 of 7 meets; his only loss was to Peters (Rabat). Peters was 2nd in Rome and Doha. Chopra is back from injuries (85.69, 4th in Doha). Weber has delayed his season start. Walcott qualifies automatically as 2025 world champion.
